mapper.select: /* 일상 건강기록 조회(경로 반려동물 기준) */ SELECT DAILY_HLTH_RCD_SN , PET_SN , DAILY_RCD_IDCT_CD , CRSD_STTS_CD , RCD_NVL , RCD_DT , DEL_YN , REG_DT , MDFCN_DT , RGTR_ID , MDFR_ID FROM DAILY_HLTH_RCD WHERE DAILY_HLTH_RCD_SN = #{dailyHlthRcdSn} AND PET_SN = #{petSn} AND DEL_YN = 'N'

/* 일상 건강기록 응답용 조회(배변상태 이름 포함) */ SELECT R.DAILY_HLTH_RCD_SN , R.DAILY_RCD_IDCT_CD , R.RCD_NVL , R.CRSD_STTS_CD , C.COM_CD_NM AS CRSD_STTS_CD_NM , R.RCD_DT FROM DAILY_HLTH_RCD R LEFT JOIN COM_CD C ON C.COM_CD = R.CRSD_STTS_CD WHERE R.DAILY_HLTH_RCD_SN = #{dailyHlthRcdSn} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N'
